name: Mantel
description:
Numbered workspaces in the top bar, and a top bar that gets out of the way. Use either, or both.

WORKSPACE NUMBERS
See which workspace you are on at a glance, instead of counting dots.
• Click a number to switch to that workspace
• Super+1 to Super+0 jumps straight there, and creates the workspace if it does not exist yet
• The workspace switcher popup no longer appears, since the top bar already shows where you are

AUTO-HIDE THE TOP BAR
The bar stays visible while nothing is in its way, and slides away when a window needs the room. Push the pointer against the top edge of the screen to bring it back. It stays put in the overview and while a menu is open.

While auto-hide is on, windows use the full height of the screen and the bar floats above them, so nothing resizes when you peek at the clock.

Both features can be turned off individually in Preferences.
